title: Epping Middle School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. April 6-9, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Epping Middle School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & Memorials Tour

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & Alexandria Guided Ghost Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Alexandria Guided Ghost Tour
  • Exploration of Old Town Alexandria
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum & Smithsonian National Zoological Park

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Meet and Greet with Representative or Senator at Capitol Hill
  • Lunch
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • DJ Dinner Cruise!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: White House Photo Stop Opp & Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum 
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: epping middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: Washington, D.C. is where history, adventure, and excitement come together — and this experience delivers it all! Students will visit the iconic Lincoln Memorial, explore George Washington's Mount Vernon Estate, and get an up-close look at American democracy with a guided tour of the United States Capitol Building. They'll also experience the thrill of a guided Ghost Tour of Alexandria, enjoy an evening DJ Dinner Cruise, and even get a White House photo opportunity. From the first stop to the last, this D.C. adventure is packed with moments your students will treasure forever!
